executiveSummary: Catastrophic floods along the Nepal-Tibet border have caused mass casualties (reports indicate more than 1,300 deaths) and thousands missing, while access constraints continue to hinder rescue and relief. Source Supporting Report Urgent WASH, health, protection and education needs are escalating in Nepal, with at least 22,000 children lacking safe water and families sheltering in temporary sites. Source Hawaii has closed schools and government offices on Oahu, Kauai and Niihau ahead of Hurricane Lowell impacts; threats include flash flooding, mudslides and tornadoes. View Article Severe flooding in eastern Texas triggered dozens of water rescues, damaged infrastructure and widespread power outages after torrential rain. Source A deadly flash flood in the Grand Canyon killed two, left at least one missing, forced 80+ air evacuations and damaged the park's primary water pipeline, prompting restrictions. Source Supporting Report China's Jiangxi/Fujian provinces reported fatalities, missing people and mass relocations as mudslides and typhoon-driven rains collapsed houses and breached a dike. View Article Indonesia's volcanic ash disrupted aviation, stranding an estimated 170,000 passengers; schools shifted to remote learning. Source Beyond immediate crises, El Niño is heightening drought, flood and heat risk across Eastern and Southern Africa, with 162 million children in exposed areas. Source

outlook72h: Hawaii: Expect continued hazardous conditions as Hurricane Lowell passes; anticipate flash flooding, landslides and service closures through the peak impact window. Source Nepal: Search and rescue likely to remain hampered by debris and damaged access; disease prevention and safe water provision are critical immediate priorities. Source Supporting Report Texas: Receding waters may reveal new infrastructure damage; continued utility restoration and debris clearance expected. Source Grand Canyon: Ongoing water restrictions and limited access likely as repairs and searches continue. Source China (Jiangxi/Fujian): Mudslide and flood residual risks persist; communities near compromised slopes and waterways should remain on alert. Source
